docs/world-model/PROGRAMME.md:1676:| C4 ★ | Aerial contest as an embodied process: jump timing / arrival / body position contesting the ball in the air, replacing scan-who-is-already-in-the-box resolution. MUST sequence with the pinned open-play box-arrival gap (crosses currently find nobody ~50% `noAerial` — a duel model without arrivals has nothing to contest) | **PHASE-0 CODE MAP DONE 2026-07-27** → [`C4-PHASE0-CODE-MAP.md`](C4-PHASE0-CODE-MAP.md) (ruling #26.4, read-only, zero code). ⭐ **Headline: the delivery is a well-built pass to a named man; the contest is a one-tick radius lottery; the arrival is ONE licensed body aimed at the WRONG RADIUS for a cross.** `~50% noAerial` is not a crossing bug — it is the arithmetic of a **1.35 m** contest radius (`constants.ts:182`) meeting a box the run system was never asked to fill. ✅ **Delivery is the healthy link** (`mechanics.ts:552-595`): lead capped at `CROSS_LEAD_MAX` 3.5 m, 18% goal-pull (0.25 was tried and fed the keeper), technique-whipped inswinger, `oneTouch` priced. Its target scorer (`PlayerBrain.ts:511-533`) ranks **the bodies already there** — it has no term for whether anyone is there, and nothing anywhere sends bodies BECAUSE a cross is coming. ⛔ **The contest is instantaneous** (`mechanics.ts:785-812`): `s = aerialSense + attacking(0.3 in the box) + (1−d/1.35)·0.35 + rng(0,0.45)` — no jump, no takeoff, no airtime, no body position, and **the die is comparable in size to every other term**. Keeper claims first inside 1.9 m (`745-776`); the chest trap pre-empts (`781`). ⛔⛔ **The arrival mismatch is the sharpest finding**: open play licenses 1–3 runners by `RUN_ROLE_W + localX/45` (`TeamBrain.ts:185-197`) and **none of them is licensed BY a cross**; the single wide-ball arriver (`205-218`) is routed to **the edge-of-box arc 16 m out** (`actionExecutor.ts:351-355`) — that is the CUTBACK target Phase 31 built, while a cross with an 18% goal-pull drops near the penalty spot. Non-runners hold `supportSpot` (`formations.ts:546-560`), which is **relative to the ball**, so a wide ball pulls the support structure toward the touchline. ⭐⭐ **And the engine ALREADY knows how to fill a box on a delivery — it only does it for corners**: 3 licensed crashers ranked by `aerialSense − dist(flag)/45` (`TeamBrain.ts:159-168`), routed to `cornerCrashSpots`, the closest one **re-routed onto the true parabola landing**, and **held 4.5 m off the spot until the taker steps up** so the crash is a timed burst (`actionExecutor.ts:304-349`). Open play has no crash count, no landing re-route, no timing. ⚠️ **The banked history constrains the design hard** (`ROADMAP.md:1246-1306`): two honest reverts at this exact seat — an openness value-field made the box EMPTIER (*"the box is a LOW-openness contested zone, so the scorer AVOIDS it"*), and the two-eye field spiked **offsides +50%**, the tell being bodies arriving **uncoordinated with the delivery**; plus the under-weighted datum that a BALANCED team already fills the box (`noAerial` 26%, `atkHeader` 33%), so the 46–54% belongs to cross-spam and the extreme WIDE archetype; plus the honest ceiling that cross→goal ≈5% here vs **1–2% in real football**, so raising conversion is the wrong target. ⚠️ **Instrument caveat for T0**: `cross-anatomy` attributes by `headersWon` deltas in a 4 s window, so a delivery CHESTED down or controlled on the ground counts as `noAerial` — the number is *"no header"*, not *"no arrival"*, and that difference is load-bearing for a duel contract. §6 leaves six open questions (which link is C4 · does the corner machinery generalize · is 1.35 m the substrate defect or is the missing thing TIME in the contest · what `attacking = 0.3` is really standing in for · what must NOT move · whether `noAerial` should be split before it gates anything) <br>⭐⭐ **DESIGN CONTRACT DRAFTED by the commander on that map (2026-07-27): [`C4-AERIAL-ARRIVAL.md`](C4-AERIAL-ARRIVAL.md)** — the six questions RULED: **C4 v1 = the ARRIVAL link** (delivery healthy-untouched; contest physics deferred — "a duel model without arrivals has nothing to contest" still binds) · **the corner machinery generalizes by HALVES** (post-kick landing re-route = observable physics, generalizes now; pre-kick staged timing needs evidence/doctrine → Stage III's perception layer, never a hand trigger) · 1.35 m stays for now (contest TIME = C5/C7-family, own stage) · **`attacking = 0.3` is a NAMED SUBSIDY** (stays in v1, T3 measures double-pay, removal its own step) · **CONVERSION IS A CEILING (I2 hard)** — cross→goal ≈5% vs real 1–2%, every stage gates non-increase; deliverable = CONTESTS never goals · **`noAerial` splits FIRST** (T0: nobody-there / arrival-no-header / header — one number, two meanings, the E5a lesson). Stages: T0 definitions+arrival census → T1 routing fix flagged (box-crash target w/ onside guard + landing re-route; offside canary from revert 2's +50% blast = hard gate) → T2 probe A/B → T3 live battery + E4 preview round. Queues BEHIND C5's start (#26.3 order) | ⛔ **T2-ARRIVAL Phase A RUN 2026-07-27 — FAIL on D1 and F2** → [`C4-T2-ARRIVAL.md`](C4-T2-ARRIVAL.md) §7 (SHA `fc66f1f6…c597`). ✅ **A0 PROCEEDED cleanly** — R3+R4 **1.36%** CI [0.76, 2.02] vs an 80% stop threshold (median need 3.35 m vs a 7.95 m budget over a 1.03 s flight = **4.86 m slack**), and the target REPLICATED on an unseen block (H3 23.03% vs banked 22.90%): **the arrival gap is ROUTING, not reachability**. ✅ **F1 confirms the defect AND closes it**: licensed bodies still on `MakeRun` at band entry **58.66% → 93.17%** — **the box empties on 41% of crosses**, and the licence takes that to 7%. ⛔ **D1 = RESOLVED ABSENCE**: C3atk **+0.41pp CI [−0.65, +1.46]**, the CI's upper bound BELOW the pre-registered 2.32pp MDE and far below the expected +5.7pp — the gate had its power and the effect is not there (**reading (b)**). Mediators agree: H3 flat (+0.14pp), min-attacker-distance **+0.069 m the WRONG way**, bodies-in-box +0.027 resolved — **they stayed and arrived no nearer the ball**. ⭐⭐⭐ **WHY: the closest licensed body was already going.** Of 66,469 live-licence ticks the branch fired on **45.6%** and had nothing to add on **54.4%** — the closest licensed body was already the registered receiver (**83%**, carrying the identical Phase-63 `landing − flightDir·2.5` re-route) or a chaser already routing to the same landing via `interceptBall` (**17%**). §2.1 asked *whether* the receiver had the re-route, never *how often he IS the closest*. ⚠️ **The pre-registered backfire HAPPENED**: licence-survival alone (A1) is C3atk **−0.75pp CI [−1.77, +0.29]** (§4.8 named it — the arriver's 16 m arc target points AWAY from the landing), and the re-route rung recovers it to ≈0 — **the two halves cancel**. ⛔ **F2 = my gate, third time, two freeze-time defects**: the population was mis-specified (36,121 `noTrace` = predicting a fire for bodies whose action isn't `MakeRun`, when the branch lives inside `case 'MakeRun'`), and the 72 `unexplained` reproduce in ONE cell on ONE seed, all at `phase: 'halftime'` with the ball frozen to the last digit — `Match.step` returns before `simTime += dt`, so the probe compared a fresh expectation against a **stale trace held across the pause**. E1/E2/E3/corner-precedence all **exactly empty** as §4.3b predicted; **#32.1 banned the coupon-collector form and I replaced it with a per-record form whose POPULATION was wrong**. ✅ I2 bounded (+0.19pp); ⚠️ the offside canary passes but **resolves POSITIVE** (+0.066/match CI [0.013, 0.117], a fifth of the band, and NOT the attacking side). Nothing shipped, both flags default OFF, `src` dormant <br>Earlier: **T2-ARRIVAL PRE-REGISTERED 2026-07-27** (#32.4) → [`C4-T2-ARRIVAL.md`](C4-T2-ARRIVAL.md). ⚠️ **The pre-registration corrects the contract's own premise**: #32.4's "post-kick landing re-route" **already exists** in open play since Phase 63 (`actionExecutor.ts:159-166`, *"the 31.9 corner principle in open play"* — attack the descent 2.5 m upstream off the shared `ballLanding`), granted to **exactly one body**, the registered pass target. T2 therefore WIDENS an existing re-route rather than adding one. ⭐⭐⭐ **And the real defect is that the box EMPTIES during the flight**: `PlayerBrain.ts:1144` gates every licensed run on `carrier ? carrier !== p : phase === 'restart' || crashLive`, so a cross clearing `ball.owner` in open play **strips `MakeRun` from every runner and the arriver** the instant it leaves the boot (fall-through: `MoveToFormationSpot`), while `assignRunners` clears `team.arriver` every tick and re-licenses only in the wide channel the ball has just left — **Phase 31.9's bug, still live in open play**, already patched twice in the identical shape (`cornerCrash`; the overlap license at `TeamBrain.ts:114-117`). That explains H3 exactly. **Intervention = the open-play analogue of `cornerCrash`**: `c4Arrival` snapshots the ALREADY-licensed bodies at the kick and holds them for exactly `ballLanding(ball).t` (derived; armed only when `cornerCrash === null`), `c4ArrivalReroute` gives the closest one the meet point — **no new license, no new count, no new scorer, nothing pre-kick**, so revert 2's offside exposure is structurally bounded and the arc cutback is untouched. Gates: **A0 reachability census first** (read-only, may stop the stage but not re-tune it; STOP if `R3+R4 > 80%` of H3, derived off D1's MDE) · X1-X6 incl. **X6 corners-untouched** · F1 licence survival ≥90% · **F2 in #32.1's per-record-with-named-exceptions form** (the ban applied to my own gate the day it was codified) · **D1 = C3atk RISES**, MDE 2.32pp vs expected ≈+5.7pp, mediators M1-M3 · I2 HARD in #31.2's interval form · **offside canary HARD at +0.29/match = ¼ of revert 2's blast, SD MEASURED pre-freeze** (2.4861/match, SD 1.8298, over-dispersion 1.35 — Poisson would have been 16% optimistic) per #29.5. ⚠️ One interpretive call surfaced for reversal: **the defence gets no equivalent re-route** (defensible — the defensive landing-chase already excludes box landings by measured design, and the defence took 71% of T1-FLIGHT's new contests unaided — but NOT run as an arm, being outside #32.4's scope). Phase B is not this stage's (#32.3: the pair audit) <br>Earlier: ⛔ **T1-FLIGHT Phase A RUN 2026-07-27 — FAIL on F2 (my own max-over-5,547 gate, fired by ONE re-struck delivery; the other 5,546 exact)** → [`C4-T1-FLIGHT.md`](C4-T1-FLIGHT.md) §7 (SHA `7a1afab2…5075`). ⭐⭐ The mechanism WORKS: launch-headable 74.02%→**100%**, **H0 54.76%→1.62%**. ⭐⭐⭐ Contests **+3.42pp** CI [2.14, 4.69] — but **71% of them defensive** (C3def +2.44 vs C3atk +0.98), and conversion moved the OTHER way, resolved: **goals 10.76%→8.72%, −2.05pp CI [−2.82, −1.35]**. Honest flight = more aerial football, fewer goals. ⭐⭐ T0R §7.4's partition question ANSWERED against the flight: **H3 of all crosses 11.74%→22.90%**, median miss 2.08→2.39 m — fixing the height ENLARGED the arrival gap, which is now the whole remaining story and T2-ARRIVAL's sized target. §2.4's stale-lead fork measured indistinguishable (#31.1 free). Phase B did NOT run (§8 stops a failed stage before the expensive half); nothing shipped, `c4Flight` default OFF and dormant <br>Earlier: ✅ **T0R+T0b RUN 2026-07-27 — PASS, every gate** → [`C4-T0R-T0B.md`](C4-T0R-T0B.md) §7 (SHA `55b2e4a8…7528`). The per-archetype budget certified T0's failed cell (930 / 867 against a 300 floor) and the census REPLICATED on two never-seen blocks while the X4 pin reproduced `cross-anatomy` exactly. ⭐⭐⭐ **T0b's ladder explains C2 with a ZERO residual**: H0 height-preempted 56.78% · H1 keeper 0.00% · H2 chest-trap 1.37% · H3 no-contender-at-height 41.85% · H4 0 of 1,460. ⭐⭐ Both dominant rungs are MARGINS: H0's balls peak at a median 1.00–1.06 m against a 1.35 m band floor, and H3's nearest body is 1.75–2.20 m away (40–66% within 2 m) — *the contest fails by about half a metre*, nobody is absent. 🎯 **RE-AIM = HEIGHT-DOMINATED** ⇒ the delivery's FLIGHT PROFILE is C4 v1's named seat (#28.4b), routing demoted further; ⚠️ archetype-dependent (CROSS 59–61% vs BAL 46–54%) and H0/H3 is a partition not a causal decomposition <br>Earlier: ⛔ **T0 RUN 2026-07-27 — FAIL, and the queue stops** → [`C4-T0-ARRIVAL-CENSUS.md`](C4-T0-ARRIVAL-CENSUS.md) §7 (SHA `21f42c3d…dd66`). Gate C1 fired on a coverage floor sized off a league-wide cross rate (held-out BAL vs PRESS 296 vs 300, mine, #24 family) AND pre-laid reading (b) fired: **`noAerial` is C0 10.90 / C1 5.70 / C2 27.95** — nobody-there is one part in eight of the number C4 v1 was aimed at. X4 reproduces the unmodified `cross-anatomy` exactly on all six combos; stability ≤1.40pp; the instrument is sound. ⭐ New: only **60–63%** of CROSS-archetype deliveries ever reach header height (BAL 81–84%) — a DELIVERY property that lands on Q1's healthy-untouched verdict. ⭐ The arriver IS nearer the cutback arc than the ball in 74–89% of crosses (map confirmed) but that cannot be the mechanism at C1 = 5.70%. Re-aiming C4 v1, re-sizing the floor, ruling Q1 and naming I2's conversion measurement are all the commander's |
docs/world-model/PROGRAMME.md:1677:| C5 ★ | First-touch decision: one-touch layoff vs control-first as a priced choice — faster-but-noisier vs slower-but-safer, priced by the EXISTING evaluators, technique-scaled execution noise; M3 touch≠control is the substrate seat (the honest-reverted M3b 忠于脚 gap is adjacent, separate). Ref: [`../efootball_engine_research_for_evofootball.md`](../efootball_engine_research_for_evofootball.md) §5/§20 — preparation-delay model (a technique-priced pause before the windup, never animation scaling), one-touch BYPASSES the delay but accuracy prices separately, settled/first-time/chase kicks are different pipelines. ⭐ **User anchor 2026-07-26 (E4 round 2 play, verbatim in VISION §3.1)** — receivers have no 停下来/护球/观察/保护性带球; instant passes feed offside men, intercepted back-passes, or scrambles. Reading: the receive-phase TIME dimension does not exist — the action layer picks among pass/carry/shoot every decision tick and **waiting is not a valued action** (a maturing run, drawn pressure, a fresh scan — none enter the current score), so pass-on-receipt is structural, not a tuning issue. Third independent arrow at this seat (E4r1 back-pass reflex · E5f/E5g chooser→release gap · this). The fix is the missing receiver repertoire (C5 hold-draw-release + C6 shield/protective carry + C7 wind-up + seat-2 scan), never a hand-slowed press. Two defect counters registered for the next audit's REPORTED set: **passes-to-offside rate** and **back-pass interception rate** | **PHASE-0 CODE MAP DONE 2026-07-27** → [`C5-PHASE0-CODE-MAP.md`](C5-PHASE0-CODE-MAP.md) (ruling #26.4, read-only, zero code). ⭐ **Headline: there is no "whether" seat.** The carrier's decision is a single-shot argmax over ways to get RID of the ball or run with it (`PlayerBrain.ts:152` builds `cands`, `785` sorts, `791` takes `[0]`), re-run from scratch every **0.15 s** (`Match.ts:717-718`, `AI_INTERVAL`), and **"not passing" resolves to CARRYING, twice over** (`787-789` empty-list fallback, `961-962` switch default) — never to standing with it. ⭐⭐ **The only time-dependent term in the whole carrier economy PENALISES waiting**: `stagnation = clamp01((staleTime−3)/5)` (`PlayerBrain.ts:176`) is applied AGAINST holding (`606`, `×(1−stagnation·0.5)`) and FOR driving (`650`, `×(1+stagnation·0.28)`), with the source comment saying it outright — *"Patience isn't free: stagnation drains it."* There is no counterpart term that pays for time. ⭐ **The HOLD seat is not empty, it is NARROW**: `HoldUp` is already an `ActionType` (`types.ts:109`), scored (`608`), executed (`actionExecutor.ts:387-405`) and already biases the next decision (`281`/`326`/`392`) — but it is gated to role `ST` or corner-hold, `backToGoal > 0.45` AND `pressure > 0.2`, and its executor is a 1.4 m drift away from the nearest opponent, not a shield. ⭐ **The wind-up seat is a hole of exactly zero ticks**: the kick fires inside the decision function (`PlayerBrain.ts:911-956`, `actionExecutor.ts:380-386` confirming *"Kick already happened at decision time"*), so no state exists in which a kick is committed but unstruck; the ACCURACY half of the body-orientation term is already ability-scaled and live (`mechanics.ts:77/82/87`), only the TIME half is missing. ⭐ **One-touch: the price exists, the CHOICE does not** — the trigger is pressure (`Match.ts:1195-1203`, nearest opponent inside `3.0 + tempo·1.5` ⇒ `firstTouchWindow = 0.28`), the cost is real and technique-scaled (`mechanics.ts:262`), the alternative is priced by `touchFailChance` (`109`), E1b's dormant heavy curve is still wired (`106`/`174`) — but **no `cands` entry ever reads `firstTouchWindow`**. ⭐ **Shield/glue (C6 adjacency)**: the ball is glued every tick (`Match.ts:1276-1283`), the one honest escape needs `Dribble` + v>2.5 + nearest opponent >4.2 m (`1244-1262`), and shielding exists ONLY as an attribute term in tackle resolution (`mechanics.ts:1771-1775`), never as body position — so **a hold cannot be attacked differently from a carry today**. §7 leaves six open design questions for the commander (candidate vs modifier · what pays for waiting · whether the stagnation penalty stays · widen `HoldUp` vs join it · whether C7 shares the contract · what can attack a hold — a free option gets taken always, the same shape as the `×1.3` subsidy E5h quantified) <br>⭐⭐ **DESIGN CONTRACT DRAFTED by the commander on that map (2026-07-27): [`C5-TIME-DIMENSION.md`](C5-TIME-DIMENSION.md)** — the six questions RULED: Hold = **CANDIDATE** never modifier (observable external state, intent privacy holds) · **the WORLD pays for waiting, the CENSUS prices it** (fork-and-force hold-k vs act-now on the attempt tables' own axis — the E2b-0 move applied to time; no invented forward-looking term) · stagnation stays **legacy-only** (time's price in the measured seat comes from the census) · a NEW generalized shield-Hold, legacy HoldUp untouched (flags-off world bit-identical) · C7 shares the contract NOT the stages (own flags/battery, after T4) · **NO FREE TIME (I1)**: every held tick attackable, hold-dominance ceiling at the live audit. Stages: T0 dormant mechanics → T1 waiting census (+ the tempo instruments the 1.1–1.2× anchor waits for) → T2 WHETHER on the measured axis (value brain only) → T3 full #20 battery → T4 E4 round → T5+ C7. Stage contracts pre-register individually (Autonomous mode) | ✅ **T0 built (FAIL, A2a/A3 on the wrong objects) → T0R PASSED 2026-07-27** · ⛔ **T1 RUN 2026-07-27 — FAIL on H1 (act-now arm, 2.99pp vs a 2.0pp tolerance disclosed as 2.1σ BEFORE the run; the three hold arms reproduce at 1.56/0.06/0.87pp and all twelve pressure rows pass H2)** → [`C5-T1-WAITING-CENSUS.md`](C5-T1-WAITING-CENSUS.md) §11 (SHA `72c187aa…8e43`, table SHA `7ea8152a…06e1`). ⭐⭐⭐ **The census itself came back resolved: waiting costs −7.55/−12.77/−16.12pp of shot probability at k=30/60/90 and concedes +1.45/+2.63/+3.55pp on top, monotone, every CI far from zero — and the release-origin twin (−6.53/−10.20/−12.40pp) closes the "the ball was better when he finally played it" defence.** A T2 chooser priced from this table would essentially never hold. Registered honestly: part of the cost is mechanical by construction (the horizon starts at the decision moment so a held tick is a spent tick), so this is *this world's* exchange rate, and Q2's answer — enrich the world, re-census (#26.5) — stands. ⭐ Tempo baseline banked: **median ownership spell 0.33 s, mean 0.68 s**, 28.34 vs 29.64 passes/min legacy vs VALUE |
docs/world-model/PROGRAMME.md:1703:| E2 | Both-sides perception (dormant build, probe-bundled), **split E2a → E2b by ruling #7**: **E2a** = census-derived base-rate prior table (committed as SHA'd data before any A/B, never adjusted after results) + pricing layer proven on E0's 120 banked states (unseen priced at prior, ZERO deleted for observability); **E2b** = both-sides A/B — evaluator = E0 corridor + E1b touch term, perceived state both sides via the shared-awareness trunk, not-looking-must-not-win directional gate, route-mix gate vs the S3b collapse signature, PERF hard gate at brain cadence. docs/world-model/PROGRAMME.md:1713:| E5 | **The value axis** (ruling #15.3): V measured by fork-and-force — what happened NEXT (shot within 4.0 s) censused per reception zone, committed as SHA'd data; the decision becomes measured-P × measured-V with no residual hand weight; central hypothesis = measured value REPRODUCES combination play without the hand-coded bonuses; then the narrow audit (§2 band + dominance + perf + the watchability instruments) | [`EDS-E5-VALUE-AXIS.md`](EDS-E5-VALUE-AXIS.md) | ✅ **E5a PASS 2026-07-26 — every gate** (§7.1, SHA `5cc529f7…2a7f`, twice byte-identical, fingerprint `57b0bdab…c673` unchanged, 759/759, zero live callers, table committed as data `0125071f…3bc9`). ⭐⭐ **The composition is a MEASUREMENT, not a weight**: P̂ × V̂ scored before any outcome predicts the conjunction it claims to estimate — clean reception AND a shot — at **4.014% vs 3.982% realized (0.03pp on 14,114 forks)**, with 7.71pp of top-vs-bottom discrimination. docs/world-model/PROGRAMME.md:1715:| E5c | **The attribution experiment** (ruling #16.4): (a) HU — a cell-targeted census top-up of the two starved inner attacking-third cells to the 400 floor, re-emitted as new SHA'd data, then the E5b probe re-run with every gate VERBATIM; (b) HM — on that residual, fork-and-force the pass to the licensed runner at pattern-active moments and ask whether the topped-up table still under-predicts what happens there, with the same moments' other candidates as the control | [`EDS-E5C-VALUE-ATTRIBUTION.md`](EDS-E5C-VALUE-ATTRIBUTION.md) | **PRE-REGISTERED 2026-07-26** — (a) X1–X4 · **U1 staging equivalence** (the fast two-walk staging must return E5a's Z6/Z7 rows exactly: 129/64 receptions, 0.09302…/0.421875 — the gate that buys the speed) · U2 rest untouched bit-for-bit · U3 committed = census · U4 ≥400 per cell per set · U5 held-out ≤5.0pp · **U6 the E5b re-run**: HU CONFIRMED iff third-man ≥0.85×, PARTIAL 0.653–0.85×, REFUTED <0.653× (the 0.05 margin on v1's 0.603× is ≈6σ on E5b's own counts), *with Y4V, the §2 band, dominance and perf all still passing*; (b) Y1–Y4 · M1 ≥600 clean receptions per arm · **M2 HM CONFIRMED iff the pattern gap (realized − predicted) ≥ +4.0pp AND the control gap is within ±2.0pp**. Stop rules: neither fires → a third cause nobody named, report and return; both fire → E5d queues against seat 2. <br>⛔ **RUN 2026-07-26 — NEITHER FIRES; the queue returns to the COMMANDER with a third cause named from the numbers** (§7.1–§7.3). ✅ **(a) PASS on every gate** (SHA `38c430e3…303e`, twice byte-identical, table SHA `a197b453…ed46`): **U1 the fast staging returns E5a's Z6/Z7 rows to the last digit**; Z6 129→**902 @ 11.97%** (held out 869 @ 12.20%), Z7 64→**400 @ 28.25%** (held out 400 @ 30.25%) against the 7.15% marginal — and Z7's banked 42.19% was the thin-sample mirage E5a flagged. ⚠️⚠️ **U1 ALSO SURFACED A DEFECT IN E5a, disclosed in §7.1**: E5a counted an arrival that never reached `attemptFirstTouch` as a reception (E2a-2's registered convention, correctly inherited) but **never simulated its value window**, entering it as a guaranteed non-shot — 34.48% of Z6 and 28.75% of Z7. Simulating them: they shoot at **7.07%/10.43%**, so those cells are deflated ≈2.4pp/2.8pp and **every other cell by an unmeasured amount**. NOT repaired (keeping the convention is what makes the topped cells comparable); re-censusing all eight and re-banking E5a is the commander's call on a banked milestone. My own probe was ALSO wrong against its contract (it excluded those arrivals, so U1 compared definitions instead of stagings) — corrected toward the pre-registration, after which U1 passes exactly. ⛔ **U6 — the E5b re-run, probe byte-unchanged, HU REFUTED: third-man 0.395×** (line 0.653×), *below* the un-topped 0.472× — the top-up made it WORSE. ✅ **But HU is CONFIRMED on the forward share**, a split the contract did not anticipate: −3.06pp → **−0.21pp**, failing to passing, because the most advanced men stopped being under-priced. Nothing else changed: Y4V 0/10,292, §2 band inside on all five, dominance 27.16%, perf 1.187×. The top-up pushed the game *further* the same way — passes/match 63.9→**56.5**, chain 3.84→**3.26**, give-and-gos 0.533→**0.255**, shots →15.54. ⛔ **(b) HM REFUTED narrowly** (SHA `1658231a…36d3`): pattern gap **+3.38pp** against a +4.0pp floor (n=608, ≈2.6σ from zero) with the **control at −0.06pp on 1,567** — the table is right everywhere else and under-predicts the licensed runner, just by less than the pre-registered band. ⭐ **B2 corrects ruling #16.3's geometric premise, measured**: third-man runners arrive Z2 51.8% / Z4 21.9% / Z3 18.3% and only **4.1% in the inner box** — the confound the ruling registered is not what the geometry does. ⭐⭐ **B4 + §7.3 name the third cause from measured quantities**: the licensed runner is a genuinely HARDER pass (clean reception **40.16% vs 51.77%** at the same moments), and per forced pass the pattern is worth **4.89% vs 3.80%** in realized shots while the chooser's own axis scores it **3.53% vs 3.83% — the composition INVERTS the true ordering**. The failure is neither coarseness nor state-blindness but **a per-option argmax over P̂ × V̂ declining a pass whose payoff is joint**; the legacy ×1.15/×1.3 multipliers were buying exactly that pass, and every one-pass shape survived because it never needed the subsidy. Three untested readings left for the commander in §7.3 — chief among them that **the joint is directly measurable on these same forks and the chooser is not using it** |
docs/world-model/PROGRAMME.md:1721:| E5e-P0 | **State-conditional value, Phase 0** (ruling #21.3): (a) H2's own power — the overlap counter re-measured across SIX league seeds with the cluster unit declared and a ruling-#20 CI verdict, before `0.468×` is trusted as a magnitude; (b) the DUAL PREMIUM — fork-and-force at overlap-active moments AND at third-man moments, realized outcome against the price the **committed attempt table** actually charges, with the same moments' unlicensed candidates as the control. Both premiums positive and powered → the seesaw reading is certified and Phase 1 (pattern-state features in the census index) may be drafted; either ≈0 → back to the commander | [`EDS-E5E-STATE-CONDITIONAL.md`](EDS-E5E-STATE-CONDITIONAL.md) | **PRE-REGISTERED 2026-07-26** — ⭐ **the sizing scout is the design's premise and is stated up front**: overlap-licence-active pass moments run at **0.065 per match** against third-man's 23.09, so every budget below is sized to that counter and none of the gate VALUES come from the scout. (a) **A0 staging pin** (cluster 1 = the E5b audit seed, reproducing its banked per-match counters to full float) · A1 ex-ante Poisson budget ≥300 OFF-arm overlap events (six clusters predict ≈948) · **A2 ruling-#20 verdict semantics** (NON-INFERIOR only if the WHOLE CI ≥0.70, REFUTED only if the upper bound <0.70, else INCONCLUSIVE) · **A3 cluster robustness** — cluster unit = LEAGUE SEED, 2,000-resample bootstrap over the six, and a disagreement with A2 forces INCONCLUSIVE · A4 the same battery on third-man at 0.85. (b) X5 · **P1 ex-ante coverage ≥2,400 pattern forks per harvest** (derived: SE ≤ δ/2.8 at δ=2.5pp, σ²=0.1222, control 3× pattern, ×1.2 for clustering) · **P2/P3 the two premiums as difference-in-differences** against the committed table, cluster unit = MOMENT, 2,000-resample bootstrap, SUPERIOR only if the lower bound >0 · **P4 control sanity ±2.0pp**, whose failure DOWNGRADES that harvest to INCONCLUSIVE and relabels it "the table is miscalibrated on this population" — E5c's design, kept · P5 determinism. ⚠️ Two boundaries registered BEFORE the run: harvest B is **off-population** (the committed table was never censused on overlap moments), and the predicates are read from **truth** because Phase 0 asks what the WORLD carries, not what a passer can see — perception gating is Phase 1's constraint under ruling #8(l). Reported never gated: the **flip benchmark** (how much the overlap runner loses the argmax by today, from the table's own prices), so a premium that is positive and behaviourally inert cannot be read as a win. Certification = X5∧P1∧P4∧P5 with BOTH premiums SUPERIOR; anything else returns to the commander. Zero `src/**` <br>✅ **(a) RUN 2026-07-26 — MEASURED; `0.468×` was a MAGNITUDE, not a count of rare events** (SHA `f962addf…8495`, twice byte-identical, 6 clusters × 1,704 matches × 2 arms). **A0 6/6** — cluster 1 reproduces the E5b audit's banked counters to the last float — and A1 clears 3.5× over (1,051 off-arm overlap events vs 300). **H2 overlap 0.516×**, pooled CI [0.465, 0.572], cluster bootstrap [0.437, 0.646] — **REFUTED by both, so A3's agreement condition holds**; **H1 third-man 0.660×**, [0.652, 0.669] and [0.546, 0.796] — also REFUTED. Both one-seed readings survive. ⭐⭐ **Three things six clusters show that one could not**: (1) **the cluster rule earns its place on H1** — the naive interval is 1.7pp wide against the bootstrap's **25pp**, a ~15× understatement of uncertainty on a statistic with 53,416 events, because the events are plentiful and the LEAGUES are not, and one cluster comes back at **1.056 — third-man IMPROVED there**; (2) H2's direction is the steadier finding despite 50× fewer events (5/6 clusters below 0.70, vs third-man straddling its floor 0.450–1.056); (3) the counter is **league-dependent, not merely rare** — flags-off overlap runs 0.059–0.168 per match across the six. <br>⛔ **(b) RUN 2026-07-26 — NOT CERTIFIED; the fork is the COMMANDER's** (§6.2, SHA `ced3459b…1f7c`, twice byte-identical, staging check identical, X5 6/6, fingerprint `57b0bdab…c673` unchanged, 809/809 tests, **zero `src/**`**). ✅ **P3 — the third-man premium is REAL against the deployed axis: +1.49pp, CI [+0.60, +2.47]** (cell rung +1.03pp, so not a band artefact), less than half E5c's +3.38pp against the composed V̂ — the attempt axis had already absorbed most of it. ⚠️ But it does **not clear its own flip benchmark**: the runner loses the argmax by 1.10pp on price and the premium's LOWER bound is 0.60pp — real, and the data cannot say it is large enough to change the decision. ⛔ **P2 — the OVERLAP premium is NEGATIVE: −3.52pp, CI [−4.78, −2.28]** (pattern −0.69pp vs control **+2.83pp**) — but the control arm is off-band, which is exactly P4's *"the table is miscalibrated on this population"* condition that the off-population registration anticipated, so the **registered verdict is INCONCLUSIVE, not REFUTED**, and the point estimate is reported under that label. ⛔ **P1 fired by SEVEN forks** (2,393 vs 2,400) and was NOT chased — ruling #2.1 forbids a budget raise outright while a ratio gate is failing at decision time. ⭐⭐ **THE READING I LABELLED AFTER THE LIVE AUDIT IS REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT**: overlap forks land **55% cell 2 / 38% cell 3 — the MIDDLE third**, 1% in cell 7, so the attacking-third price argument was about the wrong part of the pitch; and the flip benchmark comes back **−0.82pp**, meaning at the moments his licence fires **the overlap runner is already the TOP-PRICED option**. He is not losing the comparison. Second time in this slice a geometric premise about where a pattern lands has failed against measurement (ruling #16.3's was the first) — **do not reason about which cell a pattern lands in; ask the census**. ⭐⭐⭐ **The consequence for Phase 1, which is why Phase 0 sat in front of it**: measured state-conditional value would raise the third-man option and **LOWER the overlap option** — it pushes the seesaw FURTHER the way the attempt axis already tipped it instead of holding both ends up. Two limits stated plainly: harvest B measures the premium in the **flags-off** world (as every fork-and-force probe in this slice does), and the live collapse is therefore **unexplained and now sharper — it must be UPSTREAM** (fewer overlap situations developing under the value axis, or releases no longer arriving wide past the counter's stricter `|y| > 11`). One cheap probe would settle it; spending it is the commander's call |

     1	# EvoFootball Probe Contracts — the acceptance methodology
     2	
     3	> **Why this exists.** `fires ≠ works ≠ pays ≠ selected ≠ good football`. The
     4	> one-two experiment FIRED more often, "worked" mechanically — and fresh evolution
     5	> **culled it while inflating goals**. No change ships on a single scalar or a
     6	> handful of match-level stats. Every substrate/attr/gene change must prove **six
     7	> things, in order**. Companion to [`SUBSTRATE-MAP.md`](SUBSTRATE-MAP.md); this
     8	> enforces [`VISION.md`](VISION.md) §6 discipline ("一次一根杠杆, probe-first,
     9	> A/B, honest-revert").
    10	>
    11	> Ratified 2026-07-20 (user + GPT + Claude). The probe **inventory** (60+ existing
    12	> tools) is catalogued at the end; this doc adds the **contracts** they serve.
    13	
    14	---
    15	
    16	## 1. The six-layer acceptance chain
    17	
    18	Any new capability, attribute, or gene proves these **in sequence** — a failure at
    19	layer N means STOP, do not chase layer N+1:
    20	
    21	| # | Layer | The question | Evidence style |
    22	|---|---|---|---|
    23	| 1 | **Mechanism exists** | did the internal mechanism actually change? (obs-error moved, ETA sharper, first-touch faster, turn cost lower, trajectory error changed) | frozen-scene, **direct mediator** measurement |
    24	| 2 | **Gene bites correctly** | is the causal PATH right, not a shortcut? `awareness↑ → info fresher → prediction better`, **NOT** `awareness↑ → +10% tackle` | causal-path (mediator) test, not just directional |
    25	| 3 | **Capability appears** | does the world ALLOW the behaviour? (candidate generated, window exists, receiver reachable) | behaviour-possibility probe |
    26	| 4 | **It pays** | vs hold / neutral / alternative, does it improve the NEXT state? | **counterfactual** rollout (the layer we kept missing) |
    27	| 5 | **Evolution selects conditionally** | does **fresh** evo keep it in SOME ecologies, reject in others, at a real budget price? | multi-world fresh-evo + shadow-price |
    28	| 6 | **World remains healthy** | §2 watchability, readability, diversity, realism, ecology, perf, determinism | paired non-inferiority + ecological + replay clips |
    29	
    30	**The new default question** is no longer *"did behaviour X happen more?"* but
    31	*"why did it happen, what did it create, why did evolution keep it, and did it
    32	crowd out other football?"*
    33	
    34	---
    35	
    36	## 2. Six threshold TYPES (never mix them)
    37	
    38	Each gate belongs to exactly one type; state which when you write the contract.
    39	
    40	- **Exact invariant** — must hold to the bit: feature-off is bit-identical
    41	  (`fingerprint`), state ledger conserves, `watched === headless`, no illegal
    42	  states. *(vitest: `match.test`, `simRunner.test`, `rng.test`.)*
    43	  **Determinism hashes cover WORLD OUTCOMES only — wall-clock / perf numbers
    44	  are reported alongside, never hashed.** A probe cannot both hash wall-clock
    45	  and promise byte-identity; the two claims are different epistemic
    46	  categories. *(Registered from EDS E2b-1, 2026-07-25: a perf block inside
    47	  the hashed object made X3 structurally unpassable while the world itself
    48	  was proven deterministic.)*
    49	- **Directional** — only the sign is required: `awareness↑ → obs-error↓`,
    50	  `agility↑ → turn-ETA↓`. Side-balanced, enough seeds (ARCHITECTURE rule).
    51	- **Calibration** — predicted probability ≈ observed frequency: events predicted
    52	  "70% control" should land ≈70%. *(The whole point of `arrival-calibration`.)*
    53	- **Paired non-inferiority** — same-seed A/B: scramble/goals/route-mix must not
    54	  regress out of the agreed band. The verdict is *"not worse,"* not *"better."*
    55	- **Ecological** — multi-seed, multi-generation, **fresh** evo: divergence exists,
    56	  **no runaway** axis, payoff is frequency-dependent.
    57	  **Type your gate and OBEY the type**: an ecological claim gated on a single
    58	  seed is mis-typed and noise-dominated, whatever its threshold. *(Registered
    59	  from EDS E3R CE2, 2026-07-25: a one-seed style-entropy floor read 0.5797 —
    60	  FAIL — while the pre-registered robustness seed flipped the same statistic
    61	  to 1.5321 and all three mechanism discriminators said diversity ROSE.)*
    62	
    63	**Ruling #20 (2026-07-26, cross-AI audit adopted — verdict semantics and
    64	power discipline, binding on all NEW contracts):**
    65	
    66	- **CI verdict semantics replace point-threshold rules.** Equivalent /
    67	  non-inferior only if the ENTIRE confidence interval lies inside the
    68	  acceptance region; superior only if the lower bound clears the
    69	  threshold; REFUTED only if the upper bound lies below it; anything
    70	  else is verdict `INCONCLUSIVE` — never "refuted by a point estimate".
    71	- **Power calculations must declare the CLUSTER UNIT** (match / league
    72	  seed), not treat forks or moments as independent; report effective n.
    73	- **Every audit carries a family-wise fire budget**: the gate table sums
    74	  each gate's H0 fire probability; observed fires within budget are
    75	  triaged as noise-suspects (report + powered re-check), only an
    76	  over-budget audit stops the queue outright.
    77	- **Rare-event counters get Poisson-powered match budgets**: a ratio
    78	  gate on a counter with single-digit expected events cannot decide at
    79	  any tolerance — size the match count to the counter, or the gate is
    80	  mis-typed.
    81	- **The six watchability counters are HARD non-inferiority gates**
    82	  (flags-off paired) in every live-facing audit, with the user's eyes
    83	  as the final judge above them — "reported only" is retired (a
    84	  measured regression once passed 29 gates).
    85	- Ledger relabels under these semantics: E5c's HM "refuted" →
    86	  **INCONCLUSIVE** (+3.38pp, SE≈1.32, upper bound above the +4.0 band);
    87	  E3R2's CE1 waiver → **INCONCLUSIVE** (2/5 fresh seeds; multi-seed CE1
    88	  joins the pre-ship confirmatory audit).
    89	
    90	**Pattern-geometry premises are CENSUSED, never asserted (ruling #22,
    91	2026-07-26).** Where a pattern's forks land (which cells they occupy) and
    92	which comparison the pattern wins or loses are measurable census columns,
    93	not things to reason out from the pitch diagram. Two commander premises
    94	died by assertion: EDS #16.3 ("third-man runners arrive in the inner box"
    95	— measured 4.1%) and #21.3's labelled reading ("overlap lands
    96	attacking-wide and loses the argmax" — measured 55%/38% middle third, and
    97	the runner was already the top-priced option). A drafting premise about
    98	pattern geometry must cite a census row or be labelled UNTESTED and kept
    99	out of every gate derivation.
   100	
   101	**Inherited gate values must be RE-POWERED against the inheriting
   102	contract's own parameters (ruling #19, 2026-07-26).** A tolerance is only
   103	meaningful relative to the n it was powered at; inheriting the number
   104	without redoing the power calculation is an unpowered predicate in
   105	disguise. *(Registered from EDS E5d Phase 1 C3: a 5.0pp tolerance
   106	inherited from a contract with n≈1,000/bucket — 3.4σ there — met a 200
   107	bucket floor here, where it is 1.54σ and fires on noise ~11% per bucket;
   108	across two dozen buckets a false fire was near-certain by construction.)*
   109	**And an INVENTED floor must be checked against the staging's ATTAINABLE
   110	population ex ante (ruling #24, 2026-07-27)** — a coverage gate the
   111	staging cannot reach at ANY budget is mis-typed by construction. *(From
   112	EDS E5g P2: a 2,000-decision-moment floor written against a staging that
   113	contains 854 in total; six leagues × 24 seasons IS the population.)*
   114	
   115	**Reproduction gates pin STAGING and DEFINITIONS separately (ruling #18,
   116	2026-07-26): one gate per claim.** A staging gate pins counts, inputs and
   117	moment sets (drift detection); a definition gate pins outcome windows and
   118	conventions (redefinition detection). A gate that mixes both cannot tell
   119	drift from redefinition and will either be unsatisfiable or fire
   120	ambiguously. *(Registered from EDS E5d X6: counts matched 7,864/7,864 —
   121	staging clean — while the rate fired because E5a's own window start
   122	violated its own contract; the mixed gate had already needed one pre-run
   123	amendment for being unsatisfiable.)*
   124	
   125	**Watchability instruments (ruling #15, 2026-07-26): every §2-band run
   126	REPORTS forward-pass share, third-man releases, overlap releases,
   127	give-and-gos, shots and longest pass chain.** E3R passed 29 gates while
   128	watchability measurably dropped (third-man −35.7%, shots −6.0%) because no
   129	gate could see it — the user's eyes sat at the END of the chain, and these
   130	six counters cost minutes. Reported, never gated: the user's eyes remain
   131	the only watchability judge; the instruments exist so a probe can flag
   132	what previously only a play session could.
   133	- **Equivalence / flatness** — the claim is *"no effect"* / *"no longer rises"*:
   134	  must be pre-registered as an INTERVAL test (an explicit equivalence band) with
   135	  a sample size computed against the predicted effect. A strict point inequality
   136	  where the per-arm SE swamps the predicted difference is structurally
   137	  undecidable — the gate can only ever return `unexplained`, whichever way the
   138	  world is. *(Registered from EDS E1a-I2, 2026-07-25: a 0.5pp endpoint gap was
   139	  coded as "rises" where the SE of that difference was ≈5.6pp at n≈60 — the
   140	  probe was honest, the predicate was unpowered by construction.)*
   141	
   142	**Power is a FREEZE-TIME obligation, and a pre-run disclosure does not
   143	discharge it (commander ruling #29.5, 2026-07-27).** A gate you can already
   144	see is under-powered must be **re-powered or re-derived ex ante, before the
   145	freeze** — writing down that it is weak is honesty about a defect, not a
   146	licence to run with it. A knowingly ~2σ gate buys a verdict that cannot
   147	distinguish its own two readings: *the world moved* and *my tolerance was too
   148	tight* both produce the same fire, and no amount of after-the-fact prose
   149	separates them. *(Registered from C5 T1's H1: the contract disclosed, in its
   150	own committed §7.2b before the run, that the realised base rate made a 2.0pp
   151	tolerance 2.1σ instead of ≈3σ — and then ran it. It fired at ≈3.1σ on one arm
   152	while the three arms the table existed to price reproduced at 1.56 / 0.06 /
   153	0.87pp, leaving a FAIL that no one can read. The disclosure was correct
   154	conduct; keeping the gate was not.)*
   155	
   156	**A MAX-statistic over thousands of records at a tight tolerance is a
   157	COUPON-COLLECTOR gate and is FORBIDDEN (commander ruling #32.1,
   158	2026-07-27).** `max|x_i − y_i| ≤ ε` over n records does not ask the claim
   159	*"the arithmetic reached the world"*; it asks that **no single record
   160	anywhere** be pathological, and its fire probability grows with n for any
   161	fixed per-record tail. On a few thousand records it is a near-certain fire
   162	by construction, and a fire carries no information about the mechanism the
   163	stage exists to prove. Write it instead as **per-record with NAMED
   164	exception classes** (each class a world event you can point to in code), or
   165	as a **share form** (*"≥99.9% of records within ε"*) powered ex ante like
   166	any other threshold. *(Registered from C4 T1-FLIGHT's F2: worst
   167	|maxZ − apex| = 1.0219 m on exactly ONE cross of 5,547, the other 5,546 at
   168	exactly 0, byte-identical across all three arms — the exception a named
   169	world event, a ball re-struck by the same player inside its own window, so
   170	`lastTouch` never changes and the maxZ guard never trips. The arithmetic
   171	was perfect; the gate was mis-typed.)*
   172	
   173	Corollary, and the honest escape hatch: if a floor cannot be re-powered
   174	because the population will not supply the sample — the #24 check — then say
   175	so and **do not gate on it**. Report the quantity instead. An ungated
   176	measurement is worth more than a gate whose fire is uninterpretable.
   177	
   178	---
   179	
   180	## 3. Gate structure per phase (no single VisionScore)
   181	
   182	**Never** collapse the vision into `VisionScore = 0.3·realism + 0.3·diversity + …`
   183	— the moment it's one scalar, we optimise the scalar, not the football (Goodhart).
   184	Instead, every phase declares:
   185	
   186	- **Hard gates** (any fail ⇒ NO ship): determinism · neutral baseline · mechanism
   187	  direction · state-ledger conservation · §2 no-obvious-regression · no ecology
   188	  runaway · **perf non-regression** (relative to tag: live-frame p95 / sim-step p95
   189	  / allocations / headless matches·s⁻¹ — see §5.5).
   190	- **ONE primary outcome** for the phase (the thing this lever is for).
   191	- **2–4 mediators** proving the result arrived **via the intended path** (layer-1/2
   192	  variables), not a side effect.
   193	- **Diagnostics** — may move freely, do **not** decide ship.
   194	
   195	Acceptance is **probes + the user's eyes, jointly** (user 2026-07-20). Behavioral
   196	levers WILL move goals; §2 is a watchability judgement (probe proxies + play-test),
   197	**not** a goals≈2.0 veto.
   198

   201	## 4. Per-phase contract template
   202	
   203	Copy this block per phase (into ROADMAP or a phase note):
   204	
   205	```md
   206	## Hypothesis          — what real-football causality are we adding?
   207	## Substrate mechanism — what new capability exists in the world? (which S-layer)
   208	## Gene hooks          — which capability/preference/knowledge/state acts where?
   209	                         (must obey the SUBSTRATE-MAP hook table's "MUST NOT" column)
   210	## Primary mechanism probe   — the ONE mediator we measure directly (layer 1/2)
   211	## Behaviour probe     — which behaviour should now be POSSIBLE? (layer 3)
   212	## Counterfactual payoff probe — value vs hold / neutral / alternative (layer 4)
   213	## Match guardrails    — goals / scramble / spell / churn / route-mix / shape (layer 6)
   214	## Evolution gate      — does FRESH evo select it conditionally? (layer 5)
   215	## Ecology gate        — diversity kept, negative freq-dependence, no runaway? (layer 5/6)
   216	## Replay sample       — worst / median / best / largest-A-B clips (seed+timestamp)
   217	## Ship rule           — which gates are HARD fail, which are WATCH-only
   218	## Threshold types     — tag each gate: invariant | directional | calibration
   219	                         | paired-non-inferiority | ecological
   220	```

   232	`cutback-anatomy` / `width-funnel` (box-arrival) · `spill-anatomy` /
   233	`positioning-bite` / `reception-by-width` / `orientation-ab` (**first-touch — NOT a
   234	gap**) · `goal-channel-census` / `shot-context-anatomy` / `launch-anatomy` (route
   235	mix) · `freq-dependence` / `matchup-matrix` (self-balance) · `scheme-matchup` /
   236	`positioning-shape` / `run-repertoire` / `transition-anatomy` (shape/runs/transition).
   237	Gates: `offside.test`, `cutback.test`, `oneTouch.test`, `cushion.test`,
   238	`touches.test`, `blocks.test`, `aerial.test`, `combos.test`, `goalChannels.test`.

   245	| `arrival-calibration` (NEW, reliability half) | control-reliability curve: margin-bucket (`<−0.5 … >+0.5`s) → clean / contested / intercepted / died-in-flight / lose<0.5s / stable@1.5s, by pass type × zone | 3, 4, 6 |

   284	
   285	## 5.5 Probe tiers & shared telemetry (dev-cycle scaling)
   286	
   287	The dev cycle 卡 before the player's machine does — running 60+ probes (multi-world,
   288	multi-gen, A/B, matchup, visual) on every change makes a phase take hours. So probes
   289	are TIERED and share ONE trace:
   290	
   291	- **Tier 0 — every change, seconds:** unit tests · determinism invariant · frozen
   292	  mechanism scene · gene directional bite · state conservation · feature-off bit-identity.
   293	- **Tier 1 — every commit, 1–3 min:** small paired A/B · contest · arrival ·
   294	  perception-calibration · reception-survival · neutral mirror · scramble guard.
   295	- **Tier 2 — pre-ship, ~10–15 min:** calibrate · goals-warming (short) · fresh-evo ·
   296	  matchup · style-identifiability · replay-sample extraction.
   297	- **Tier 3 — nightly/milestone:** multi-world long evo · freq-dependence · 24–40 gens ·
   298	  full ecology · visual matrix · large counterfactual rollouts.
   299	
   300	**Shared telemetry (build once):** one sim run emits a trace — `TelemetryEvent`,
   301	`DecisionTrace`, `PossessionTransition`, `PassLifecycle`, `ContestLifecycle`,
   302	`TaskLifecycle` — and many probes analyse the SAME trace offline. Kills the "run 500
   303	matches 10× for 10 metrics" waste. ⚠ **Invariant: the trace is flag-gated,
   304	PURE-observational, and OFF by default** (live + fingerprint runs never emit) — emitting
   305	must never change sim results (determinism), and per-event allocation stays out of the
   306	hot path. Perf is measured by the phase-level profiler in `Match.step` (physics /
   307	perception / prediction / candidates / coordination / mechanics / snapshot-building).
   308	
   309	## 6. Replay sampling — 让你少看,不是不看
   310	
   311	Watching can't be fully replaced (rhythm/narrative/continuity live in the eye). But
   312	cut the cost from "dozens of matches" to **~20 auto-mined clips per phase.** Each
   313	probe emits `replay seed + timestamp`; auto-extract four sets: **worst 5**
   314	(max scramble / max prediction error / longest uncovered task) · **largest A/B diff
   315	5** · **median 5** · **best 5**. Watch each **twice**: pass 1 no overlay (是否像
   316	足球), pass 2 with perception/ETA/task/candidate-score overlays (diagnose why). This
   317	kills the "only the highlight looks great, 90% of normal play is weird" failure.
   318	
   319	---
   320	
   321	## 7. Watchability dashboard (§2, one view — don't read them scattered)
   322	
   323	- **Chaos:** contest time-share · loose-ball time-share · `pinballChainLength` ·
   324	  <3s ownership flips · touches before a controlled spell · decision-target flip
   325	  rate · time with ≥3 bodies converging on the ball · duplicate-function bodies in
   326	  a zone.
   327	- **Football-formation:** controlled-possession duration · goals by route · goals
   328	  after a line-break · goals after a contest/deflection chain · receiver
   329	  stable-control rate · chances from **structured** attack vs scramble · attacks by
   330	  width / central / combination progression · defensive shape recovered before a
   331	  chance.
   332	- **Fluency:** dead-ball time · restart setup · interruption frequency · ball-out
   333	  rate · action-commitment duration · players reversing target without acting.
   334	
   335	**Do not** demand all possessions get longer or all goals come from build-up — the
   336	vision wants **multiple readable routes**, not forced tiki-taka.
   337	
   338	---
   339	
   340	## 8. Counterfactual boundary + open feasibility items
   341	
   342	- **Rule — online counterfactual = NEVER, offline = ORACLE.** The live AI must use a
   343	  CHEAP value estimator (S7 bounded lookahead: ETA / pitch-control / line-break /
   344	  estimated future options / local danger). `counterfactual-value` is the OFFLINE
   345	  oracle that CERTIFIES the cheap estimator actually flags the valuable runs. Never
   346	  clone-and-rollout inside the live sim — it explodes exponentially and reads like a
   347	  god-compute chess engine (violates §1's "long eyes," not omniscient search).
   348	
   349	- **✅ FEASIBILITY SPIKE + POC DONE (2026-07-20) — use STRUCTURAL DEEP-CLONE (Option A).**
   350	  My first read-only pass recommended the conservative replay-to-T; a deeper
   351	  separate-session POC then proved **deep-clone is the better call and cheap**:
   352	  - `Match` has ONE randomness source (`readonly rng: Rng`, `Match.ts:252`; whole state
   353	    = a single u32 `s`; **no `Math.random`/`Date`/`performance.now` in the sim path** —
   354	    only UI/render/profiler). `private` is erased at runtime → `rng.s` is read/settable
   355	    externally, so **no sim file needs editing** to capture/restore it.
   356	  - CLOSED state graph: fixed `DT=1/60` (full match = 14,400 steps), no cross-run module
   357	    state (the "A-then-B" determinism test proves it) beyond a dt-keyed trig cache + a
   358	    const config flag. The ONLY object refs needing remap are `Ball.owner`/`lastTouch`;
   359	    `Team.chasers/marks/runners` are Set/Map (structural, not JSON, clone); everything
   360	    else is gid-indexed, no closures (`ActionState` is pure data).
   361	  - A generic prototype-preserving, cycle-safe cloner gives **byte-identical
   362	    continuations**: POC (`scripts/probes/_poc-clone.ts`) = **25/25 cases (5 seeds × 5
   363	    freeze ticks incl. half-time) identical for 4 s + identical full-match remainder**;
   364	    negative control (1-bit RNG nudge) **DIVERGES** (assertion non-vacuous). Cost
   365	    **~275 µs/clone vs ~94 ms replay-to-T ≈ 342× cheaper**; replay-to-T stays the
   366	    trivial fallback.
   367	  - ✅ **Mainline primitive now landed (2026-07-21):** `sim/cloneState.ts` promotes the
   368	    field-agnostic cloner with a 4s byte-identical continuation regression, and
   369	    `pass-target-counterfactual` is its first real consumer. It freezes the state just
   370	    before a live pass decision and forces chosen-target vs alternative-target branches
   371	    from identical RNG. The first S7 run correctly **failed** payoff (509 pairs:
   372	    alternative/chosen dominance 34.4/35.6%; team possession 53.4→49.1%), proving the
   373	    oracle can veto a plausible-looking estimator rather than rubber-stamp it.
   374	  - ❌ **S7c static two-sided threat also failed honestly (2026-07-21):** a
   375	    pre-registered shooting-window + turnover-corridor extension left 363 paired
   376	    rollouts, but alternative/chosen dominance was 34.4/35.0% and own-team
   377	    possession fell 53.4→47.1%. The implementation was fully reverted with no
   378	    coefficient/tolerance sweep; the negative audit remains in
   379	    `world-model/S7C-THREAT-POTENTIAL.md`.
   380	  - ❌ **S7d temporal flight interception also failed complete payoff
   381	    (2026-07-21):** the route margin itself calibrated strongly (risky pass
   382	    received/intercepted 64.7/28.6%; safe 88.7/3.5%), but adding it to S7 left
   383	    only a +0.9pp alternative dominance edge and reduced own possession
   384	    51.1→47.0% over 219 paired rollouts. Its implementation was fully reverted;
   385	    `pass-target-counterfactual` retains first-controller/pass-resolution anatomy
   386	    so the next hypothesis can distinguish flight failure from post-reception
   387	    failure. See `world-model/S7D-FLIGHT-INTERCEPTION.md`.
   388	  - ✅ **The retained anatomy found the next causal boundary:** within the 212
   389	    paired branches where both intended targets first-controlled, the original
   390	    S7b alternative/chosen dominance becomes 38.2/28.8%, possession 65.6→67.5%,
   391	    progression +1.181m and xG +0.006. S7 therefore needs a contingent transition
   392	    model (`receive / teammate / opponent / dead / loose` → conditional next
   393	    state), not another independent Pareto feature and not another live cut.
   394	  - ✅ **Horizon sensitivity confirms the split:** at 3.0/4.5/6.0s, aggregate
   395	    dominance gaps are −1.2/−3.5/+2.2pp and never pass, while macro-possession
   396	    direction flips. The `bothTarget` conditional gap stays +9.4/+5.6/+8.0pp
   397	    with positive progression and xG throughout. Keep 3.0s as the frozen total
   398	    baseline; use event-anchored diagnostics to design S7e, not to cherry-pick
   399	    a favourable fixed horizon.
   400	- ⭐ **This does NOT gate S7.** Live bounded-lookahead uses the CHEAP analytic estimator
   401	  (ETA / pitch-control / next-options), never a Match rollout (too slow per-tick under
   402	  either scheme) — the clone-vs-replay choice only touches the offline oracle, so the
   403	  online=never / offline=oracle boundary above holds cleanly.

   309	## 6. Replay sampling — 让你少看,不是不看
   310	
   311	Watching can't be fully replaced (rhythm/narrative/continuity live in the eye). But
   312	cut the cost from "dozens of matches" to **~20 auto-mined clips per phase.** Each
   313	probe emits `replay seed + timestamp`; auto-extract four sets: **worst 5**
   314	(max scramble / max prediction error / longest uncovered task) · **largest A/B diff
   315	5** · **median 5** · **best 5**. Watch each **twice**: pass 1 no overlay (是否像
   316	足球), pass 2 with perception/ETA/task/candidate-score overlays (diagnose why). This
   317	kills the "only the highlight looks great, 90% of normal play is weird" failure.

   340	## 8. Counterfactual boundary + open feasibility items
   341	
   342	- **Rule — online counterfactual = NEVER, offline = ORACLE.** The live AI must use a
   343	  CHEAP value estimator (S7 bounded lookahead: ETA / pitch-control / line-break /
   344	  estimated future options / local danger). `counterfactual-value` is the OFFLINE
   345	  oracle that CERTIFIES the cheap estimator actually flags the valuable runs. Never
   346	  clone-and-rollout inside the live sim — it explodes exponentially and reads like a
   347	  god-compute chess engine (violates §1's "long eyes," not omniscient search).
   348	
   349	- **✅ FEASIBILITY SPIKE + POC DONE (2026-07-20) — use STRUCTURAL DEEP-CLONE (Option A).**
   350	  My first read-only pass recommended the conservative replay-to-T; a deeper
   351	  separate-session POC then proved **deep-clone is the better call and cheap**:
   352	  - `Match` has ONE randomness source (`readonly rng: Rng`, `Match.ts:252`; whole state
   353	    = a single u32 `s`; **no `Math.random`/`Date`/`performance.now` in the sim path** —
   354	    only UI/render/profiler). `private` is erased at runtime → `rng.s` is read/settable
   355	    externally, so **no sim file needs editing** to capture/restore it.
   356	  - CLOSED state graph: fixed `DT=1/60` (full match = 14,400 steps), no cross-run module
   357	    state (the "A-then-B" determinism test proves it) beyond a dt-keyed trig cache + a
   358	    const config flag. The ONLY object refs needing remap are `Ball.owner`/`lastTouch`;
   359	    `Team.chasers/marks/runners` are Set/Map (structural, not JSON, clone); everything
   360	    else is gid-indexed, no closures (`ActionState` is pure data).
   361	  - A generic prototype-preserving, cycle-safe cloner gives **byte-identical
   362	    continuations**: POC (`scripts/probes/_poc-clone.ts`) = **25/25 cases (5 seeds × 5
   363	    freeze ticks incl. half-time) identical for 4 s + identical full-match remainder**;
   364	    negative control (1-bit RNG nudge) **DIVERGES** (assertion non-vacuous). Cost
   365	    **~275 µs/clone vs ~94 ms replay-to-T ≈ 342× cheaper**; replay-to-T stays the
   366	    trivial fallback.
   367	  - ✅ **Mainline primitive now landed (2026-07-21):** `sim/cloneState.ts` promotes the
   368	    field-agnostic cloner with a 4s byte-identical continuation regression, and
   369	    `pass-target-counterfactual` is its first real consumer. It freezes the state just
   370	    before a live pass decision and forces chosen-target vs alternative-target branches
   371	    from identical RNG. The first S7 run correctly **failed** payoff (509 pairs:
   372	    alternative/chosen dominance 34.4/35.6%; team possession 53.4→49.1%), proving the
   373	    oracle can veto a plausible-looking estimator rather than rubber-stamp it.
   374	  - ❌ **S7c static two-sided threat also failed honestly (2026-07-21):** a
   375	    pre-registered shooting-window + turnover-corridor extension left 363 paired
   376	    rollouts, but alternative/chosen dominance was 34.4/35.0% and own-team
   377	    possession fell 53.4→47.1%. The implementation was fully reverted with no
   378	    coefficient/tolerance sweep; the negative audit remains in
   379	    `world-model/S7C-THREAT-POTENTIAL.md`.
   380	  - ❌ **S7d temporal flight interception also failed complete payoff
   381	    (2026-07-21):** the route margin itself calibrated strongly (risky pass
   382	    received/intercepted 64.7/28.6%; safe 88.7/3.5%), but adding it to S7 left
   383	    only a +0.9pp alternative dominance edge and reduced own possession
   384	    51.1→47.0% over 219 paired rollouts. Its implementation was fully reverted;
   385	    `pass-target-counterfactual` retains first-controller/pass-resolution anatomy
   386	    so the next hypothesis can distinguish flight failure from post-reception

    52	  generic openness field EMPTIES the box (the box is a low-openness
    53	  contested zone — an "open space" scorer avoids exactly the places
    54	  worth being); the two-eye field spiked **offsides +50%** (bodies moved
    55	  on value with no delivery coordination). Both are canaries below, and
    56	  both say the same thing: an eye that scores SPACE instead of measured
    57	  OUTCOMES re-fails the same way.
    58	* **The scramble is this slice's residual by measurement**: E4 round 2
    59	  filed "everyone converging on the ball" as improved-but-unsolved under
    60	  the triple, and the registered fix is this slice, not the chooser.
    61	* **The house has already measured what looking is worth here**:
    62	  corridor read 39.72pp vs distance memory 6.64pp (E2b-0), look-pressure
    63	  6.59% of live pass moments (E3R), and the E5f class decomposition —
    64	  perception is real, priced, and cheap enough to run live (1.20×).
    65	
    66	## 2. What already exists (assets this design must reuse, not rebuild)
    67	
    68	1. **The perception trunk** — per-player pulled snapshots (ruling #13.3:
    69	   PULL semantics, lazily materialised at consumption moments), awareness
    70	   attr, FOV/retention/keyed error frozen by E2b-1R's honesty rules, and
    71	   the three-class ladder READ / SEEN-UNREAD / UNSEEN with its measured
    72	   pricing precedent (#8(l), #9.3).
    73	2. **The fork-and-force harness** — E2a-2's banked capability with named
    74	   future consumers; the intervention grammar (force ONE choice, live
    75	   machinery does everything else, bit-identical reproduction of the
    76	   unforced choice as the harness gate) transfers to stations verbatim.
    77	   ⭐ And unlike every tracking-literature ghosting model, **our forks are
    78	   causally coherent by construction** — defenders and teammates respond
    79	   through the live sim inside the fork, so C-OBSO's "physically
    80	   inconsistent counterfactual" critique does not apply. The remaining
    81	   honest limit is the house population law: the census is measured under
    82	   the incumbent policy of the other eleven bodies.
    83	3. **The census discipline** — attempt-conditioning with every window
    84	   simulated (E5d's lesson: no adjudication gating, no zero-value
    85	   conventions), SHA'd tables as data, C3R floor-vs-tolerance powering,
    86	   #24 attainability checks, #20 CI/cluster verdicts, #18 separated
    87	   staging/definition pins.
    88	4. **The incumbent as control** — `emergentStation` stays the flags-off
    89	   world bit-identically; every probe A/Bs against it; VISION §1's own
    90	   law binds: the eye ships only if it BEATS the incumbent on §2 +
    91	   watchability, "更有原理" alone does not ship.
    92	5. **The prior-art digest** — ten lineages surveyed; what Stage III takes
    93	   is their DECOMPOSITIONS (accessibility ≠ value ≠ off-ball credit), and
    94	   what it rejects is their fitting: every published model either assumes
    95	   omniscience, hand weights, or observed-choice data. The survey's five
    96	   open questions are ruled in §4.
    97	
    98	## 3. Scope of the first cut (v1)
    99	
   100	IN — one seat, the player's off-ball station:
   101	
   102	1. **The station census (instrument first, the house move):** at sampled
   103	   off-ball moments, fork the deterministic world and force ONE player's
   104	   station target to each candidate in a fixed relative lattice; measure
   105	   the SIGNED outcome (score face and concede face within a frozen
   106	   horizon, every fork's window simulated). Tables per face, SHA'd,
   107	   committed as data.
   108	2. **The eye, dormant then flagged:** each player evaluates the SAME
   109	   candidate lattice through his OWN pulled percept, prices candidates
   110	   from the census tables at his perceived context, composes the two
   111	   faces through GENE-mapped weights (§4-Q3), and moves toward his
   112	   best-priced station. Replaces the `emergentStation` output behind a
   113	   flag; the incumbent path stays verbatim.
   114	3. **The support seat's one defect:** the candidate lattice is
   115	   ball-relative and symmetric, so stations BEHIND the ball are reachable
   116	   — drop-to-receive becomes a priceable candidate, not a scripted move.
   117	   (`supportSpot`'s consumer wiring is mapped at P0 before any deeper
   118	   claim on it.)
   119	
   120	OUT of v1, explicitly: **the coach eye** (the global-pattern layer —
   121	TeamBrain modes, runner licences, overload/side calls stay legacy
   122	verbatim; VISION's own sequencing: 先装球员这只); **box-arrival
   123	anticipation** (the crash trigger reading delivery evidence is the
   124	C4-Stage III handshake, registered there, designed at P5+); **marking /
   125	duel assignments** (defensive stations move, WHO marks WHOM does not);
   126	**any new gene** (§4-Q6); **any legacy-path behaviour change** (flags-off
   127	bit-identical); offside LAW changes (the line is read, never moved).
   128	
   129	## 4. Design invariants — the survey's five questions + the house's three, ruled
   130	
   131	* **Q1 — the state is the player's OWN percept, priced by class.** The
   132	  eye consumes the pulled snapshot, never truth. A candidate whose
   133	  context depends on unseen bodies prices at the census MARGINAL for the
   134	  perceived features (the E2b-1 ladder: READ full-featured, within
   135	  retention BANDED, UNSEEN marginal); no truth-fallback by the back door
   136	  (#8(l)). The census itself is fitted on TRUE context (the world's
   137	  honest exchange rates) and consumed through perceived context — the
   138	  same architecture E2b-1R proved live, so the fidelity question is
   139	  already answered in this repo, not reopened.
   140	* **Q2 — the census cell is a TARGET-CHOICE intervention.** Fork at real
   141	  off-ball moments, force the station target for a frozen window W, live
   142	  machinery does movement/decisions/physics both teams; outcome =
   143	  what happened within horizon H from the force, both faces, every
   144	  window simulated (E5d). The harness gate: forcing the incumbent's own
   145	  target reproduces the unforked match bit-identically. W and H are
   146	  pre-registered per stage, and the P1 contract must state ex ante what
   147	  a station can and cannot causally reach at its horizon (a station is
   148	  slower machinery than a pass — H_station > H_pass is expected, its
   149	  value derived from P0's measured decision cadences, not invented).
   150	* **Q3 — the preference seat opens HERE, and only here.** The chooser's
   151	  preference-seat fork stayed closed (#13.2, CE2R) because a measured
   152	  probability needs no taste. A tactical STANCE is not a probability:
   153	  how to trade the score face against the concede face IS style, and
   154	  VISION mandates it evolves. So: **component VALUES are census-measured,
   155	  component WEIGHTS are genes** — the two-engines junction, cashed as
   156	  designed. Guard rails: exactly TWO measured faces in v1 (score,
   157	  concede — one signed axis split, so nothing double-counts); weights
   158	  map from EXISTING tactical genes (§4-Q6); no hand constant anywhere in
   159	  the composition; and the E5d anti-composition law binds WITHIN a face
   160	  (never P̂×V̂ where EV̂ is measurable).
   161	* **Q4 — crowding is a FEATURE, not a rule.** Don't-crowd must emerge
   162	  from a measured fact: local teammate density enters the census feature
   163	  set, so "a third body in an occupied zone adds little" is a TABLE ROW,
   164	  not a repulsion constant. The incumbent's hand repulsion stays only in
   165	  the legacy path. Same treatment for the offside structure: the
   166	  perceived offside line is field geometry the eye reads (VISION input
   167	  ④), stations beyond it price at their measured (poor) face values —
   168	  and revert 2's +50% blast becomes a hard canary, not a hand clamp.
   169	* **Q5 — stability is gated, not assumed.** The survey's sharpest
   170	  warning (a correct field can still oscillate, pile up, duplicate runs,
   171	  abandon rest defence under simultaneous consumption) is the incumbent's
   172	  hand-tuning in disguise. v1's answer: station decisions run at the
   173	  measured station cadence with COMMITMENT (a chosen station persists
   174	  its window unless the percept materially changes — the banked
   175	  short-lived-commitment substrate, AUTHORITY §2, finally consumed), and
   176	  P2/P3 carry pre-registered stability instruments: station-switch rate,
   177	  pairwise-spacing distribution, ball-convergence index, rest-defence
   178	  occupancy, duplicate-run rate — gated against the incumbent's own
   179	  measured bands.
   180	* **Q6 — no new genes in v1.** Weights map from the EXISTING tactical
   181	  genome (attackingWidth, formationDepth, defensiveCompactness,
   182	  pressIntensity, supportDistance, coverBias — the P1 contract freezes
   183	  the mapping ex ante); serialized keys keep meaning, the budget law is
   184	  untouched, evolved populations stay comparable. Dedicated
   185	  preference genes (risk appetite as its own axis) are a named FOLLOW-UP
   186	  with their own budget-law step — after the eye proves the seat.
   187	* **Q7 — intent privacy holds.** The cooperation reading (队友协同 —
   188	  "winger wide and high = a cross is coming") consumes EXTERNAL evidence
   189	  through the percept only: positions, velocities, ball flight,
   190	  observable wind-ups (C7's future output). No teammate's private
   191	  intent, no coach-truth broadcast, no commander (D-ROTATE's grave).
   192	  Familiarity/doctrine as PRIORS on interpretation stay A4's seat,
   193	  explicitly not smuggled in here.
   194	* **Q8 — symmetry by construction.** Every outfielder on BOTH teams runs
   195	  the same eye over his own percept (the S3b/vision-attr law is built
   196	  in, not bolted on). The two faces make the same machinery the
   197	  attacking eye in possession and the defensive eye out of it — and the
   198	  **shape DIFFERENCE between the faces is an acceptance instrument**
   199	  (VISION 2026-07-27 anchor), measured, not asserted.
   200	
   201	## 5. Stages (each pre-registers its own contract; IDs P0–P5 — the
   202	T-series is C4/C5's, and this track must not collide)
   203	
   204	```text
   205	P0  CONSUMER MAP + INSTRUMENTS (read-only, zero src): the full consumer
   206	    web of station targets (formationSpot / emergentStation /
   207	    supportSpot / runTarget / mark targets — who reads them, when, at
   208	    what cadence, file:line); the measured station-decision cadence
   209	    (the basis for W, H and the commitment window); the stability +
   210	    shape instruments DEFINED (station-switch rate, pairwise spacing,
   211	    ball-convergence index, rest-defence occupancy, duplicate-run rate,
   212	    attack/defence shape delta) and their incumbent BASELINES measured
   213	    and banked. The E5-style "one number, two meanings" sweep runs over
   214	    every instrument before anything gates on it.
   215	P1  THE STATION CENSUS: dormant force-seam (flag-gated, zero live
   216	    callers, flag-off bit-identical), fork-and-force over the candidate
   217	    lattice at sampled off-ball moments; SIGNED two-face outcome, every
   218	    window simulated; feature set frozen ex ante (closed, small: e.g.
   219	    zone × threat band × possession face × local-density band ×
   220	    offside-relative flag — final set is P1's pre-registration under
   221	    C3R floors + #24 attainability); tables SHA'd as data. Harness
   222	    gate: forced-incumbent reproduces the unforked match bit-identically.
   223	P2  THE EYE, dormant A/B: percept-priced candidates, gene-mapped face
   224	    composition, commitment windows; probe A/B vs the incumbent on the
   225	    P0 instruments; offside canary (revert 2) + box-occupancy canary
   226	    (revert 1, using C4 T0's split arrival classes as the instrument);
   227	    determinism twice; flag-off identity pinned.
   228	P3  LIVE AUDIT: the full #20 battery — §2 band, watchability counters
   229	    HARD (both combination counters simultaneously, cluster semantics),
   230	    perf 1.25×/1.50× (consumption-scoped: station-cadence pulls,
   231	    candidate-scoped materialisation — the E2b-1R levers, pre-named),
   232	    multi-seed ecology (CE2R form), co-evo restoration, plus this
   233	    slice's central hypotheses: H-SCRAMBLE (ball-convergence improves
   234	    vs incumbent — the E4 r2 ② residual, directional, powered) and
   235	    H-SHAPE (attack/defence shape delta emerges without a mode table
   236	    writing it). Any fire → commander.
   237	P4  E4 ROUND: the user plays (per-slice gate, #26.1); the preview mode
   238	    list gains the audited arm per the E4-PREP-2 pattern (closed list,
   239	    only audited combinations reachable).
   240	P5+ THE COACH EYE + the C4 handshake (delivery-evidence crash trigger)
   241	    + dedicated preference genes — each its own contract, only after
   242	    P4's verdict.
   243	```
   244	
   245	## 5.5 The arrival hypothesis, reality-calibrated (commander amendment,
   246	2026-07-27, user-ratified — supersedes the "price the landing" framing)
   247	
   248	Real box attack happens BEFORE the kick, and C4's own chain measured the
   249	same thing (T2: presence without pre-aim moved nothing; the corner
   250	machinery works because it stages pre-kick). The P5+/C4-handshake
   251	hypothesis is therefore posed as:
   252	
   253	* **Evidence read, pre-kick**: the eye reads observable carrier context
   254	  (teammate wide + high + body set to deliver — external evidence only,
   255	  intent privacy holds) and prices the box ZONES ahead of the kick. The
   256	  last-half-second landing re-route is already banked dormant (C4) and
   257	  is the correction, never the mechanism.
   258	* **Division of labour EMERGES**: near/far/spot splits are never
   259	  hand-assigned — they fall out of don't-crowd (an occupied zone prices
   260	  lower in the next man's eye) plus per-player gene/attr differences.
   261	  A4's doctrine, when it opens, sharpens the split as a shared PRIOR
   262	  (latency/coordination), never revealing hidden truth.
   263	* **Timing comes from reading the crosser, not from wanting the space**
   264	  — revert 2's +50% offsides was value without the evidence read; the
   265	  offside canary stays HARD on this hypothesis forever.
   266	* **Wasted runs are the honest price**: evidence-driven anticipation
   267	  is sometimes wrong (the cross never comes; the run recycles).
   268	  Acceptance instruments must not penalize recycled runs as waste —
   269	  a censored run is evidence working, not a defect.
   270	* Measured with C4's banked T0b/T2 ladders (C3atk, the H3 half-metre)
   271	  per ruling #34.3.
   272	
   273	## 6. Gate sources (named now, frozen per stage at pre-registration)
   274	
   275	P0's banked incumbent baselines (the stability/shape instruments); the
   276	committed attempt tables for outcome-axis comparability; the E5f/E5g/E5h
   277	banked integers wherever a staging is reused; PROBE-CONTRACTS in full
   278	(#20 CI/cluster + fire budgets · #19/#24 floors powered AND attainable ·
   279	#18 separated pins · #22 pattern-geometry-is-censused — which for this
   280	slice reads: WHERE a station family lands is a census output, never an
   281	assertion); perf budget from `docs/perf/baseline.json`; §2 band verbatim;
   282	the watchability instruments as HARD gates per #20 fork B.
   283	
   284	## 7. Stop rules
   285	
   286	Any stage FAIL → the queue stops, the fork returns to the commander; no
   287	stage rescues a neighbour by tuning. The offside canary or the
   288	box-occupancy canary firing stops the queue outright (the two reverts'
   289	graves are load-bearing). A DEGENERATE ATTRACTOR (a station family the
   290	eye never leaves, or a collapse of the spacing distribution — the
   291	positional twin of always-heavy) is a hard stop with its own
   292	pre-registered form at P2/P3. Perf misses → report, no honesty shaving,
   293	no budget raise. Population law (#26.5): any live substrate change (C5,
   294	C4, C6) invalidates P1's tables — the SHIPPING table must be censused at
   295	the substrate HEAD it deploys on; an early P1 run on the incumbent world
   296	is design calibration only and must say so on its face.
   297	
   298	## 8. Sequencing and the implementation slot (#26.3(iv), now open)
   299	
   300	The road-B dependency order stands: **C5 → C4 → re-measure → joint value
   301	only on the residual** (#26.3), with Stage III's contract now in
   302	existence alongside C5's. The commander's recommendation for the slot —
   303	**RATIFIED by the user 2026-07-27, binding as written**:
   304	
   305	* **P0 is gap work** — read-only, zero src, executor-runnable in a C5/C4
   306	  queue gap exactly like C4 T0 (it competes only for session time, not
   307	  for the one-experiment-in-flight slot).
   308	* **P1–P4 queue BEHIND C4's T3** on the population law: C5 and C4 both
   309	  intend live landings; censusing the station tables before the world
   310	  they deploy into exists would guarantee a re-census. If C5/C4 stall at
   311	  their own gates, the slot question returns here rather than defaulting.
   312	* The eye's design does NOT block on C5/C4 results — this contract is
   313	  complete now precisely so the slot decision is free to move if road-B
   314	  priorities shift.
   315	
   316	## 9. What Stage III unlocks on PASS
   317	
   318	The first positioning in this game's history that is chosen rather than
   319	drawn: 回撤接应、内切、包抄、超载、强弱侧 as table rows a gene-weighted
   320	eye discovers, not behaviours we wrote; attack and defence shapes that
   321	differ because the faces price differently, with the difference itself
   322	measured; the scramble residual addressed at its registered seat; and
   323	the substrate every later seat stands on — the coach eye's global field,
   324	C4's evidence-based crash timing, A4's doctrine priors, D6's POV view
   325	(render what the eye believes). Registered non-claims: overlap stays
   326	where honest measurement puts it (#25); conversion ceilings inherited
   327	wherever C4's instruments are shared; nothing here ships without beating
   328	the incumbent in the user's own eyes at P4.
